classification_rule: Broad religious categories are demographic tools, not substitutes for traditions, denominations, schools, practices or theology.
adjacent_classification_rule: Religious-adjacent records cover cults, mystery traditions, deity cults, occult/esoteric orders, initiatory societies, Satanic movements and anti-religious currents without implying that these categories are equivalent.
integrity_rule: Every profile must distinguish historical reconstruction, community self-description, demographic estimate, interpretive comparison and project-symbolic material.
adjacent_integrity_rule: Ancient cults, modern revivals, outsider accusations, conspiracy narratives and documented organizations must remain separate layers.
